subject: The framework's own state lives in documents rather than in data
recordedOccasion: from the owner's proposal that a JSON config become the single source of truth for statuses, states and counts.
severity: F1 and F3 are high — both have recorded incidents, and F3's are bugs in the checks the framework is trusted by. The rest are structural and cost attention rather than correctness.
feltAt: every `STATUS-` and `STATE-` tag, all five `INDEX.md` files, every `findings-manifest.md` and `metadata.md`, and `bin/verify-findings-counts.sh`, `-structure.sh`, `-headers.sh`
scope: session management. The fix lands in the bundle and session file shapes, and in the checkers that read them
read: `docs/legend.md`, the ladder and the three vocabularies
all five `INDEX.md` files and all six `findings-manifest.md`
the owner's two draft config files, 2026-09-07

findings.statement: A bundle's status is carried in a filename, so every transition is a delete plus a create
findings.sectionHeading: F1 — the status is in the filename

findings.statement: 88 count and status cells are typed by hand, and a checker exists only to catch them drifting
The framework's own data is parsed back out of rendered markdown, and that parser has been wrong twice
findings.sectionHeading: F3 — the data is parsed back out of the rendering

findings.statement: Structured fields and free-form prose share a file with nothing marking the boundary
findings.sectionHeading: F4 — no boundary between what is authored and what is derived

findings.statement: Authority is assigned to documents, so every consumer must parse prose to read a fact
findings.sectionHeading: F5 — authority sits on documents, not on data

resolution.whatWasDone: Authority moved from documents to data: 54 metadata.json files, and the STATUS-/STATE- tag files deleted

findings.statement: A header field that is optional **and repeatable** cannot be represented by either draft, and this bundle carries three of them
findings.sectionHeading: F6 — a repeatable field the data cannot hold

resolution.whatWasDone: Every repeatable field is an array, and Relates to became a projection over typed edges

findings.statement: The derived bundle status has an else branch that asserts nothing, so a derivation bug always lands there
findings.sectionHeading: F7 — the derivation's else branch asserts nothing

findings.statement: Each vocabulary has exactly one activity-named status, and it is the one a name cannot carry
findings.sectionHeading: F8 — one activity-named status per vocabulary, and the thing a name cannot carry

findings.statement: An edge kind is defined by a description and a behaviour, and the two can disagree
findings.sectionHeading: F9 — an edge kind's description and its behaviour can disagree

decisions.decision: Findings are addressed as `<bundle>/F<n>`, relationships are typed edges, an edge is stored in the bundle whose session asserted it, stored edges are assertions, and `Relates to` becomes a projection
§9 step 3 changes from *write this line* to *assert this edge* in the revision that ships the projection, and not before
decisions.sectionHeading: D2 — the procedure changes when the format exists, not before

contributions.contribution: Read the two draft config files and `schemas.html`; added F6, the draft review below, and a live instance of F4 in `0039`'s own header
